player_prompt.intro:
Uyimdlali {player_id} ({piece}). Mdlali odibanisa nguye ({opp}).
Ngcwalise imikhuba njengo '[a2 a3]' (ku → ku).
- Umkhuba odibanisa ngumzuzu odlule phezulu kwisithelo esikhulu.
- Ukuthatha kwiphi iphondo elingaphambi kwendlu yomdlalo odibanisa ngayo, elandela kwenye indawo esikhulu.
Ukuthatha kipi kwiphi kungabiza {score_per_capture} iphondo.
Umdlalo uaphela emva kwemikhuba {max_moves} ngeliwa noma mdlali engeke akwazi ukukhuba.
